# Ayatsuri2D reference sources

Repository: https://github.com/Yoru-KenomoVT/ayatsuri_2d

Pinned commit: `9025819c5cbbb4d53abb3bfcfde9d913c3d78764`

The editor's `export_moc3.py` is adapted from the GPL-3.0-or-later upstream
`crates/import/src/moc3_export.rs`. The original writer, project license and
licensing explanation are retained here. The section-layout reference and its
MIT license/notice are retained under `crates/openmoc3/`.

This directory contains attribution/reference sources, not the upstream editor
application, build system or its unrelated modules. Upstream files copied here
were verified byte-for-byte before the old development checkout was removed.
